name: [UPD4]Skate And Glide
desc:
✨Welcome to Skate And Glide!✨ 

🚩In this thrilling game, you and your friends will skate up incredible high-rise structures, such as the Leaning Tower of Pisa, Mount Everest, the Great Wall, and other legendary landmarks. 

How To Play: 
🛹Skating Challenge: Reach the highest point in the world🛹 
💰Collect Coins: Unlock the highly sought-after pets💰 
🪢Unlock Skates: Blazing speed and dazzling rewards await🪢

❤️Thank you to all our amazing players for your continuous support!
